summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The VanEck Solana ETF (VSOL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long sol, short usd currency. The fund provides passive exposure to the price of Solana (SOL) less expenses and other liabilities. The shares allow investors to track the performance of Solana, without directly owning and managing the digital currency. VSOL was launched on Oct 30, 2025 and is issued by VanEck.
